actions.action: Inspect the root system by gently removing the plant from its pot
Get a new pot only 1-2 inches wider and about 1 inch deeper, preferably with drainage (grower's pot inside ceramic, or terracotta)
If the pot has no drainage, add a half-inch layer of grower's charcoal at the bottom
Add a half-inch layer of fresh potting soil to the bottom of the new pot
Snip off any dark, mushy roots with sterilized shears
Gently massage the root ends to loosen them
Place the plant in the new pot and fill soil to the previous level, leaving half-inch clearance
Gently water the plant and place it in suitable light

verdict.reason: The generic repotting article identifies root-bound signs, such as roots emerging from the pot, and advises repotting only one size larger, which matches the confirmed fix; nothing in it is likely to harm the plant.
